cohort: The study included 591 extremely premature infants (EPIs) admitted to NICU, Senior Department of Pediatric, PLA General Hospital between May 1, 2015, and May 1, 2022.
finding: Early-onset sepsis was not found to significantly increase the overall incidence of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) in extremely premature infants, but it was associated with a higher incidence of severe ROP.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a covariate that differed between the EOS and non-EOS groups and was matched for in the analysis, but no specific finding related to mode of birth and ROP was reported.
